notes:
Volim Mail 1.0 Build 129 — Settings, compose and list polish.

Settings: the Shortcuts table, Templates list and Profiles/Quick Steps/Prompts lists now use the Dawn theme surfaces instead of white and grey; the window opens at a compact 900×800 size, the sidebar colour runs to the top of the window, and the window animates open and closed from the sidebar's Settings row. Profiles, Quick Steps, Prompts and VIPs are redesigned as top-aligned cards (VIPs adds at the top, lists alphabetically, and can remove entries). The Theme picker is a row of preview tiles, Mailbox Backup and Software Update sit in their own cards, Privacy's blockers are grouped under Content Blockers, the Encryption and Connect a Client cards have proper spacing, and a single-address account no longer shows a sender pop-up.

Mail: opening or closing the Assistant column no longer collapses the list, sidebar or preview pane; the toolbar search field is centred on the window; the sender card appears only after resting on the sender's name for a second and disappears as soon as you move away or scroll; Context-card links open the referenced conversation in its own window; the reply composer collapses the quoted message behind a Gmail-style ··· control that expands and collapses in place.

Testing note: every Pro feature is unlocked in this build and the upgrade prompt is disabled. The Google sign-in button is now "Add Gmail Account".

This early-access build is signed with the existing Apple Development identity and a separately signed update manifest. It is not notarized. Apple Developer ID distribution is deferred; first-time installation may require normal macOS approval. Existing installations use the signed GitHub update feed.

The update preserves existing mail data and settings.
